#   pip install uv
#   export VLLM_VERSION=0.32.0 CUDA_VARIANT=cu129
#   uv pip install --no-cache "vllm==${VLLM_VERSION}" \
#       --extra-index-url "https://wheels.vllm.ai/${VLLM_VERSION}/${CUDA_VARIANT}" \
#       --torch-backend=${CUDA_VARIANT}
# Resulting build: vllm 0.32.0+cu129, torch 2.13.0+cu129
